question.text: What proportion of independent directors is required on the board of a Credit Rating Agency if the board is chaired by an executive director?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI's Credit Rating Agencies framework, if the board of a CRA is chaired by an executive director, half of the board shall comprise independent directors. If the board is chaired by a non-executive director, one-third of the board shall comprise independent directors. The Trap: One-third applies when the board is chaired by a non-executive director, not an executive director. One-fourth and two-thirds are unrelated proportions. Note: The higher independent-director threshold for executive-chair boards is part of the SEBI CRA governance norms in the Credit Rating Agencies chapter.
